TANCH.justification: The identification terminates when the plant's 12-primitive tuple matches one of the 11 canonical imscriptions. The lattice boundary ⊣=𐑡 closes the system: no plant falls outside the 11 types.

AFWD.justification: The Operator moves forward through the plant's body: serration → shear instruction, trichome density → compound location, phyllotaxis → winding number. Each channel is a directed morphism >𐑩 from observation to pharmaceutical meaning.

AREV.justification: After morphological assignment, the method reverses: consult taxonomic keys, verify phytochemical markers, confirm traditional use. This contravariant pass <𐑿 checks the forward reading against external databases.

CLINK.justification: Identification follows a fixed sequence: morphology → taxonomic key → phytochemistry → traditional use. Each step requires the output of the prior. Composition ⋈=𐑞 chains these into a single inference.

IMSCRIB.justification: The plant body is the program: 'the leaf does not describe its medicine, it executes it.' Trichome density IS the endpoint criterion; Fibonacci phyllotaxis IS the cycle counter. Self-reference ⊙=⊙ is the core epistemic principle.

EVALF.justification: Each primitive evaluation that refutes a trait (e.g., absent serration → not Type I shear instruction, trivial winding → not Type VI) registers ⊥=𐑖. The F-arm accumulates negative constraints.
